questions.question: 生产工单中，每个工单状态分别有多少个工单？
questions.SQL: SELECT "status", COUNT(*) FROM "fact_production_order" GROUP BY "status"

questions.question: 2025年的交付评分平均是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG("delivery_score") FROM "fact_supplier_eval" WHERE substr("eval_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 当前账龄合计最高的客户名称是什么？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."cust_name" FROM "fact_ar_aging" f JOIN "dim_customer" p ON f."cust_id" = p."cust_id" GROUP BY p."cust_id", p."cust_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."current_month") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 计划产量合计最高的产品名称是什么？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."prod_name" FROM "fact_production_order" f JOIN "dim_product" p ON f."prod_id" = p."prod_id" GROUP BY p."prod_id", p."prod_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."planned_quantity") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 产出量合计最高的产品名称是什么？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."prod_name" FROM "fact_product_cost" f JOIN "dim_product" p ON f."product_id" = p."prod_id" GROUP BY p."prod_id", p."prod_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."output_qty") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 2026年排放物类型为颗粒物的环境监测记录有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_env_record" WHERE substr("record_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "emission_type" = '颗粒物'

questions.question: 有多少个销售订单的状态是“undelivered”？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_sales_order" WHERE "status" = 'undelivered'

questions.question: 状态为“inactive”的员工的报销金额合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."amount") FROM "fact_expense" f JOIN "dim_employee" p ON f."emp_id" = p."emp_id" WHERE p."status" = 'inactive'

questions.question: 2025年的报销金额合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("amount") FROM "fact_expense" WHERE substr("expense_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 2026年，银行账号为 SYN-ACCOUNT-0006 的付款笔数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_payment_out" WHERE substr("payment_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "bank_account" = 'SYN-ACCOUNT-0006'

questions.question: 哪位业务员的报价单单价合计最高？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."emp_name" FROM "fact_quotation" f JOIN "dim_employee" p ON f."emp_id" = p."emp_id" GROUP BY p."emp_id", p."emp_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."unit_price") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 2026年评估日期中，后果等级为“catastrophic”的风险评估有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_risk_assessment" WHERE substr("assess_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "consequence" = 'catastrophic'

questions.question: 特种工程塑料车间的财产损失合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."property_loss") FROM "fact_incident" f JOIN "dim_workshop" p ON f."workshop_id" = p."workshop_id" WHERE p."workshop_name" = '特种工程塑料车间'

questions.question: 2026年收款方式为银承的收款笔数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_payment" WHERE substr("payment_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "payment_type" = '银承'

questions.question: 2025年的平均维护费用是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG("cost") FROM "fact_maintenance_record" WHERE substr("maint_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 特种工程塑料车间的天然气用量合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."gas_m3") FROM "fact_energy_consumption" f JOIN "dim_workshop" p ON f."workshop_id" = p."workshop_id" WHERE p."workshop_name" = '特种工程塑料车间'

questions.question: 按排放物类型统计环境监测记录数，分别有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT "emission_type", COUNT(*) FROM "fact_env_record" GROUP BY "emission_type"

questions.question: 有多少条IoT数据的单位是“%”？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_iot_data" WHERE "unit" = '%'

questions.question: 2026年下次维护日期在2026年的月度检修维护计划一共有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_maintenance_plan" WHERE substr("next_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "maint_type" = '月度检修'

questions.question: 计划产量合计最高的产线名称是什么？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."line_name" FROM "fact_production_plan" f JOIN "dim_production_line" p ON f."line_id" = p."line_id" GROUP BY p."line_id", p."line_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."planned_quantity") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 每种事故描述分别发生了多少次？
questions.SQL: SELECT "description", COUNT(*) FROM "fact_incident" GROUP BY "description"

questions.question: 状态为“inactive”的员工，其回款目标年度合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."year") FROM "fact_payment_target" f JOIN "dim_employee" p ON f."emp_id" = p."emp_id" WHERE p."status" = 'inactive'

questions.question: ABS/PC合金车间的蒸汽合计是多少吨？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."steam_tons") FROM "fact_energy_consumption" f JOIN "dim_workshop" p ON f."workshop_id" = p."workshop_id" WHERE p."workshop_name" = 'ABS/PC合金车间'

questions.question: 位置描述为“青岛一厂B栋”的车间下，产线对应的设备运行记录一共有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_equipment_runtime" f JOIN "dim_production_line" p ON f."line_id" = p."line_id" JOIN "dim_workshop" q ON p."workshop_id" = q."workshop_id" WHERE q."location" = '青岛一厂B栋'

questions.question: 2026年退货原因是“颜色与样板不符”的退货有多少笔？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_return" WHERE substr("return_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "reason" = '颜色与样板不符'

questions.question: 每个单位分别有多少条安全目标记录？
questions.SQL: SELECT "unit", COUNT(*) FROM "fact_safety_objective" GROUP BY "unit"

questions.question: 产品线名称为“PP改性系列”的库存记录数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_inventory" f JOIN "dim_product" p ON f."prod_id" = p."prod_id" JOIN "dim_product_line" q ON p."prod_line_id" = q."prod_line_id" WHERE q."prod_line_name" = 'PP改性系列'

questions.question: 维护类型为“季度大修”的维护计划一共有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_maintenance_plan" WHERE "maint_type" = '季度大修'

questions.question: 2026年状态为“inspected”的收货单有多少张？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_goods_receipt" WHERE substr("receipt_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "status" = 'inspected'

questions.question: 2026年入库的库存在库天数合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("storage_days") FROM "fact_inventory" WHERE substr("warehouse_date",1,4) = '2026'

questions.question: 付款条件为“月结60天”的采购订单，对应产生了多少条应付账款记录？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_ap" f JOIN "fact_goods_receipt" p ON f."gr_id" = p."gr_id" JOIN "fact_purchase_order" q ON p."po_id" = q."po_id" WHERE q."payment_terms" = '月结60天'

questions.question: 联系人姓名为“郭经理”的供应商，其相关采购订单行一共有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_po_line" f JOIN "fact_purchase_order" p ON f."po_id" = p."po_id" JOIN "dim_supplier" q ON p."supplier_id" = q."supplier_id" WHERE q."contact_person" = '郭经理'

questions.question: 应付账款中，每个状态分别有多少条记录？
questions.SQL: SELECT "status", COUNT(*) FROM "fact_ap" GROUP BY "status"

questions.question: PA改性车间的蒸汽合计是多少吨？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."steam_tons") FROM "fact_energy_consumption" f JOIN "dim_workshop" p ON f."workshop_id" = p."workshop_id" WHERE p."workshop_name" = 'PA改性车间'

questions.question: 2026年检验结果为“fail”的收货单有多少张？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_goods_receipt" WHERE substr("receipt_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "inspection_result" = 'fail'

questions.question: 制造商为“示例机械C”的设备，其固定资产的折旧记录一共有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_depreciation" f JOIN "dim_fixed_asset" p ON f."asset_id" = p."asset_id" JOIN "dim_equipment" q ON p."equipment_id" = q."equipment_id" WHERE q."manufacturer" = '示例机械C'

questions.question: 2025年的付款金额合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("amount") FROM "fact_payment_out" WHERE substr("payment_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 有多少条环境监测记录的浓度单位是 mg/L？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_env_record" WHERE "unit" = 'mg/L'

questions.question: “PP挤出1线”的告警总数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_alarm" f JOIN "dim_equipment" p ON f."equipment_id" = p."equipment_id" JOIN "dim_production_line" q ON p."line_id" = q."line_id" WHERE q."line_name" = 'PP挤出1线'

questions.question: 哪条产线的负荷时长合计最高？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."line_name" FROM "fact_equipment_runtime" f JOIN "dim_production_line" p ON f."line_id" = p."line_id" GROUP BY p."line_id", p."line_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."plan_run_hours") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 2025年的单位电耗合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("unit_energy_consumption") FROM "fact_energy_consumption" WHERE substr("record_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 产品线名称为“ABS/PC合金系列”的产品成本记录一共有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_product_cost" f JOIN "dim_product" p ON f."product_id" = p."prod_id" JOIN "dim_product_line" q ON p."prod_line_id" = q."prod_line_id" WHERE q."prod_line_name" = 'ABS/PC合金系列'

questions.question: “PA挤出3线”的停机次数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_downtime" f JOIN "dim_equipment" p ON f."equipment_id" = p."equipment_id" JOIN "dim_production_line" q ON p."line_id" = q."line_id" WHERE q."line_name" = 'PA挤出3线'
